transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you're all aware, we have 1,200 cast aluminum housings on hold due to cosmetic residue from the forming operation. I need to make a decision on whether to authorize rework and release the campaign plan, but before I can do that, I want to make sure we've gone through the proper pre-authorization review. That means I need input from process engineering, maintenance, quality, and environmental health and safety. Can each of you give me your assessment of the situation and whether the ultrasonic cleaning cell is ready to handle this rework, along with any concerns from your area?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important finding from my process trial. I completed a trial yesterday and found that the residue can be successfully removed from only 900 of the 1,200 housings using the ultrasonic cleaning cell. The remaining 300 housings have embedded residue that cannot be removed by this method and must remain on hold. I have not yet entered this result in the production release system, so I wanted to bring it to everyone's attention now before we proceed with the pre-authorization review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance issue with the ultrasonic cleaning cell. During my weekly walkdown, I inspected the cell and found that the circulation-pump seal must be replaced before the cell can be used. This will require exactly 4 hours of planned downtime. I identified the issue but have not yet opened the maintenance work order, so I'm bringing it to everyone's attention now so we can factor it into the campaign plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share an important requirement from the customer control plan that I confirmed this morning. Every reworked housing must receive dimensional scanning, and the plan requires exactly 30 reworked housings to be retained for customer review. I received the revised plan from the customer portal this morning but have not yet updated the local inspection instruction, so I wanted to bring this to everyone's attention now so we can factor dimensional scanning capacity and the 30-unit retention requirement into the campaign plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: From an environmental health and safety standpoint, I need to share the results of my waste review for this campaign. I determined that the spent cleaning solution from this rework campaign must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes and shipped under a waste manifest. I confirmed the classification with our site's waste contractor this week, but I have not yet updated the area waste-board notice, so I wanted to bring this to everyone's attention now so we can factor the waste handling requirements into the campaign plan.
transcript.speaker: A5
